KRONOS Re Dashboard — User & Developer Guide

The KRONOS Re Dashboard is the primary interface for the AI-native Bermuda reinsurance sidecar platform. It provides actuaries, CIOs, risk officers, and regulators with real-time analytics, AI-assisted workflow management, and regulatory reporting.

Platform Overview

Key Features

AI Chatbot

The KRONOS AI assistant helps users build and manage actuarial workflows through natural conversation:

  • Explore modules — Ask "What can KRONOS do?" to discover available capabilities
  • Propose workflows — Describe what you need; the AI builds a multi-step pipeline
  • Review DAGs — Visualize workflow steps as a directed acyclic graph
  • Approve and execute — Human approval required before any execution

Workflow Approval

Every AI-proposed workflow requires human approval before execution:

  • Policy enforcement — Configurable rules for role requirements, review time, and separation of duties
  • Cryptographic signing — HMAC-SHA256 tokens bind approvals to approver identity
  • Audit trail — Full record of who approved what, when, and why
  • Revocation — Approvals can be revoked at any time

ALM Analysis

Real-time asset-liability management analytics:

  • Duration gap analysis (asset vs. liability modified duration)
  • Key-rate duration (KRD) profiles across tenor buckets
  • Cash flow matching reports
  • Spread analysis (asset yield vs. liability cost-of-funds)
  • Rebalancing alerts when gaps exceed thresholds

Risk & Capital

Regulatory capital computation and stress testing:

  • BSCR (Bermuda Solvency Capital Requirement) by risk module (C1-C8)
  • VaR/CVaR at configurable confidence and horizon
  • Prescribed stress test scenarios
  • PE partner solvency dashboard

Trading & Hedging

AI-drafted hedge recommendations with human CIO approval:

  • Hedging strategy templates by product type
  • Pre-trade impact simulation
  • Position tracking with live Greeks
  • GAAP ASC 815 hedge effectiveness testing

Regulatory Reporting

Automated report generation with human actuary sign-off:

  • GAAP reporting (ASC 944, ASC 820)
  • STAT reporting (NAIC Life Annual Statement)
  • BSCR filing (BMA quarterly/annual)
  • Draft memo generation (AI drafts, human signs)

Architecture

Technology Stack

Component Technology
Frontend Plotly Dash + Bootstrap + dash-ag-grid
API FastAPI (mounted on same server)
AI Engine Anthropic Claude SDK (claude-sonnet-4-6)
Process Manager ChatHub (JupyterHub-style)
Authentication OAuth2/OIDC
Data DuckLake (DuckDB + Parquet on S3)

Service Ports

Service Port URL
Dashboard + API 8050 http://localhost:8050
ChatHub 8060 Internal only
UserProcesses 9100-9999 Internal only

Security Model

  • Per-user isolation — Each user gets their own AI process with resource limits
  • Environment stripping — AI processes never receive approval secrets or database credentials
  • Token verification — All inter-service communication uses HMAC tokens
  • Path traversal protection — All file operations validate paths stay within user workspace
  • OAuth2 — All API endpoints require authentication

Getting Started

Quick Start

# Start all services (requires Redis)
./scripts/aadhya/start.sh start

# Dashboard available at http://localhost:8050
# API docs at http://localhost:8050/api/docs

Pages

Page URL Audience
AI Chatbot /chatbot All users
Workflow Viewer /workflow?id={id} Actuaries, CIO
Solvency Overview / PE partners, CRO
Liability /liability Actuaries
ALM /alm ALM committee
Trading /trading CIO, traders
Risk /risk CRO, BMA
Reports /reports Regulators

REST API

All endpoints are under /api/v1/kronos. Key endpoint groups:

  • /chatbot — AI conversation and workflow management
  • /approvals — Approval creation, revocation, and audit trail
  • /alm — ALM snapshots and analytics
  • /risk — BSCR and stress testing
  • /trading — Hedge recommendations and positions
  • /reporting — Report generation and retrieval
  • /liability — Cash flow projections
  • /ingestion — Census data upload

Authentication via OAuth2 bearer token or session cookie.
